import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_10/test_0.csv"
    # Target file path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_10/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source data
    df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path)

    # Inspect columns in source:
    # ['LBE', 'CONGRESSIONAL_DISTRICT_CODE', 'LEGISLATIVE_DISTRICT_CODE', 'PRECINCT', 'PARTY', 'POLLS', 'EARLY_VOING', 'ABSENTEE', 'PROVISIONAL', 'ELIGIBLE_VOTERS']

    # Target schema:
    # ['PRECINCT': string, 'ELIGIBLE_VOTERS': integer, 'POLLS': integer, 'EARLY_VOING': integer, 'ABSENTEE': integer, 'PROVISIONAL': integer]

    # Transformation plan:
    # - Group by PRECINCT (the key for aggregation)
    # - Sum all numeric columns: ELIGIBLE_VOTERS, POLLS, EARLY_VOING, ABSENTEE, PROVISIONAL
    # - Convert ELIGIBLE_VOTERS to integer (source has float)
    # - Ensure all columns are integer except PRECINCT (string)

    # Group by PRECINCT and aggregate sums
    agg_df = df_source.groupby('PRECINCT', as_index=False).agg({
        'ELIGIBLE_VOTERS': 'sum',
        'POLLS': 'sum',
        'EARLY_VOING': 'sum',
        'ABSENTEE': 'sum',
        'PROVISIONAL': 'sum'
    })

    # Convert ELIGIBLE_VOTERS and other numeric columns to int
    # Use round before converting to int to avoid truncation issues
    agg_df['ELIGIBLE_VOTERS'] = agg_df['ELIGIBLE_VOTERS'].round().astype(int)
    agg_df['POLLS'] = agg_df['POLLS'].round().astype(int)
    agg_df['EARLY_VOING'] = agg_df['EARLY_VOING'].round().astype(int)
    agg_df['ABSENTEE'] = agg_df['ABSENTEE'].round().astype(int)
    agg_df['PROVISIONAL'] = agg_df['PROVISIONAL'].round().astype(int)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    agg_df = agg_df[['PRECINCT', 'ELIGIBLE_VOTERS', 'POLLS', 'EARLY_VOING', 'ABSENTEE', 'PROVISIONAL']]

    # Save to target CSV
    agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
